numeric_ks_drifted.description: Same numeric column shifted by +1000; snapshot_id omitted so the auto-generated uuid4 path is exercised.

numeric_ks_stable.description: 200 distinct numeric values, identical reference and current.

numeric_merged_unique_2_ztest.description: Numeric column whose reference+current union holds exactly 2 values.

numeric_merged_unique_3_chisquare.description: Numeric column at the lower chi-square boundary (merged unique == 3).

numeric_merged_unique_5_chisquare.description: Numeric column at the upper chi-square boundary (merged unique == 5).

numeric_merged_unique_6_ks.description: One value past the chi-square boundary (merged unique == 6).

numeric_nan_cleaned_to_1000_ks.description: 1001 raw rows with one missing value; cleaning brings N back to 1000, so the small-sample branch is selected despite the raw count.
numeric_nan_cleaned_to_1000_ks.routing_expectation: cleaned N<=1000, Numerical, merged unique>5 -> ks_stat_test

numeric_nan_cleaned_to_1001_wasserstein.description: 1002 raw rows with one missing value; cleaned N is 1001.
numeric_nan_cleaned_to_1001_wasserstein.routing_expectation: cleaned N>1000, Numerical, merged unique>5 -> wasserstein_stat_test

numeric_reference_n_1000_ks.description: Reference cleaned N is exactly 1000, the inclusive small-sample bound.

numeric_reference_n_1001_jensenshannon.description: Large sample but low cardinality (merged unique == 4).

numeric_reference_n_1001_wasserstein.description: One row past the bound (cleaned N == 1001) flips the numeric branch.
